summary:
**Starchain GeoTrendix** is an AI-powered Earth observation and trend detection platform designed to help people understand how our planet is changing.

The project transforms complex Earth science data from NASA into accessible, interactive insights. Users can investigate environmental changes across geographical regions, explore historical trends in variables such as temperature, precipitation, soil moisture, and vegetation, and visualize findings through interactive maps and time-series charts.

By combining NASA Earth observation data, statistical trend analysis, and AI-powered interpretation, the platform helps identify increasing or decreasing trends, evaluate their statistical significance, and explain scientific findings in clear, understandable language.

Our goal is to make Earth system analysis more accessible, helping researchers, students, and the public explore environmental patterns and better understand changes occurring across our planet.
details:
Project Details — Starchain GEO TRENDIX

Starchain GeoTrendix is an AI-powered Earth System Trend Detection platform that transforms complex satellite and environmental datasets into understandable scientific insights. It is designed to help users investigate how different components of Earth's systems change over time and across geographical regions.

How it works

Users can start an investigation by selecting a geographical area, choosing environmental variables, or asking a question using natural language through the AI assistant. The system identifies relevant Earth science datasets, retrieves historical observations from NASA data resources, and processes them for analysis.

The platform focuses on environmental variables including:

  • Atmospheric temperature and climate patterns.
  • Precipitation and rainfall.
  • Soil moisture and water availability.
  • Vegetation and land-surface conditions.
  • Atmospheric and environmental indicators.

The collected data is organized into time series and geographical visualizations. Statistical methods, including linear regression, the Mann–Kendall trend test, and Sen's slope estimation, help identify increasing or decreasing trends, measure their magnitude, and evaluate their statistical significance. An AI-powered interpretation layer translates the analytical results into clear explanations, helping users understand what has changed, where it has changed, and how significant those changes are.

Benefits and intended impact

Our goal is to make Earth system data more accessible and useful for people who may not have advanced programming or remote-sensing expertise. By combining multiple environmental indicators, the platform can help users investigate relationships between different Earth system components, explore regional environmental changes, and identify patterns that may deserve further scientific investigation.

The intended impact includes supporting environmental research, encouraging data-driven decision-making, improving scientific literacy, and making NASA Earth observation resources easier to explore for students, researchers, educators, and the public.

Technology and development tools

The project architecture combines several technologies:

  • NASA Earthdata resources: Earth observation and scientific datasets, including GPM, GLDAS, MODIS, and MERRA-2.
  • Python: Data retrieval, processing, cleaning, statistical analysis, and scientific calculations.
  • Scientific Python libraries: NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Statsmodels, and PyMannKendall.
  • n8n: Workflow automation, API orchestration, and coordination of AI-powered investigation processes.
  • Large Language Models (LLMs): Natural-language understanding, investigation planning, and explanation of analytical findings.
  • FastAPI: Backend services and communication between data-processing components and the application.
  • Streamlit, Plotly, and geospatial visualization libraries: Interactive dashboards, maps, and time-series visualizations.

Creativity and innovation

The creative aspect of Starchain GeoTrendix is its combination of Earth observation, statistical science, and AI-driven interaction in a unified investigation experience. Instead of requiring users to manually search through complex scientific datasets and interpret technical outputs, the platform aims to let them investigate environmental questions through a natural-language interface.

A key design principle is that AI does not replace scientific analysis. Statistical calculations are performed by dedicated analytical processes, while AI helps users formulate investigations and understand the resulting evidence.

We also considered data quality, geographical and temporal resolution, missing observations, statistical uncertainty, transparency of data sources, and the limitations of environmental measurements. These considerations are important to ensure that detected trends are presented responsibly and are not confused with proven environmental causes.

Ultimately, Starchain Geo Trendix aims to turn large-scale Earth observation data into an accessible, interactive, and evidence-based way of understanding our changing planet.
